_about: HELD, NOT IN THE GAME (Paolo 10/27, rule 296: 'no more cooking until October 31st, just listen and record for when the chats cook again'). The upright re-draw of the last ten towns (rule 292(c)), phone left and phone right, drawn in Blender and turned into pictures before the hold, NOT shipped and NOT checked on the screen. To put them in: copy 'ground' entries into slices/settlement_ground_towns/settlement_ground.json towns[name], and 'walk' entries into settlement_walk.json pictures, then shoot the four layouts (tools/bohemia_four_layouts_shoot_10_27_26.js) and check no tap sits under the phone. The pictures are already in slices/settlement_ground_towns/<slug>_tall_<side>[_night].webp. Towns marked taps_in_pad keep a shop in the phone's corner and ship without phone_ground (the screen lifts them).
